preconditions.description: s1 and s2 are lists of strings

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) for s in s1) and all(isinstance(s, str) for s in s2)
preconditions.description: all elements in s1 and s2 are strings
the length of s1 and s2 are within the specified constraints

preconditions.expression: 5 <= len(s1[i]) <= 25 and 5 <= len(s2[i]) <= 25 for i in range(len(s1))
preconditions.description: the length of each string in s1 and s2 is within the specified constraints

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(any(s2[i] in s1[j] or s2[i] == s1[j][:len(s2[i])] or s2[i] == s1[j][-len(s2[i]):] for j in range(len(s1))) for i in range(len(s2)))
postconditions.description: the integer returned is the count of strings in s2 which is a prefix or suffix in s1
